problem_statement: Support header_rows in astropy/io/ascii/rst.py. Make only the minimal production-source changes in that file. The RST constructor must accept header_rows and pass it to FixedWidth. In RST.write, after super().write(lines), do not use a hard-coded separator index: set idx = len(self.header.header_rows), then return [lines[idx]] + lines + [lines[idx]]. In RST.read, set self.data.start_line = 2 + len(self.header.header_rows) before calling the parent reader. Do not modify tests, docs, or any other files; do not create reproduce scripts, helper scripts, or scratch files. The final patch must contain only astropy/io/ascii/rst.py and exactly these required changes.
